game.name: Dead Rising 2 : Off the Record (USA, Europe)(En,Ja,Fr,Es,It,Ko)
game.desc: Dead Rising 2: Off the Record is an action game. It features the hero of the first episode, Frank West, in a reinterpretation of the zombie attack on Fortune City. New enemies, vehicles and especially a new story change the game.
